Observe.description: Wait for additional diagnostic evidence without changing radio or traffic parameters.
Observe.risk: Unsafe for safety-critical missions when posterior risk is already high.

WiFiRelief.description: Reduce Wi-Fi contention by relieving channel access pressure or reshaping Wi-Fi-heavy traffic.
WiFiRelief.risk: May be ineffective when degradation is driven by BLE/RID occupancy or mobility fading.

BLEAvoid.description: Avoid BLE/Remote-ID occupancy windows or shift C2 timing away from periodic occupancy.
BLEAvoid.risk: May not improve video burst pressure or mobility fading.

LinkAdapt.description: Apply link/rate/path adaptation for mobility-induced fading or blockage.
LinkAdapt.risk: Can add switching overhead if used without mobility evidence.

VideoShape.description: Pace or shape video/sensing traffic to reduce queue pressure.
VideoShape.risk: Can harm inspection utility if used when video is not the bottleneck.

FallbackProtect.description: Enter conservative protection mode that prioritizes C2 safety under uncertainty or mixed causes.
FallbackProtect.risk: Can sacrifice throughput and payload utility if overused.
